title: Centered Mob Eyes
body:
# About the pack

Not much to say, **Centered Mob Eyes** is a very simple but cursed resourcepack that does exactly what the name suggests - it stops many passive and hostile mobs from being cross-eyed by making them actually look forward thanks to upscaling and editing the textures.

## FAQ

**Q:** The pack doesn't work! / Some of the textures are broken!
> **A:** You're on a Minecraft version that doesn't currently support the pack. Check the [versions tab](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/centered-mob-eyes/versions) for compatible Minecraft versions.

**Q:** Can you downgrade this to 1.XX?
> **A:** Maybe 👀

**Q:** What about compat with other packs?
> **A:** While this probably could be made with vanilla shaders or CEM, I instead opted for just changing the textures themselves making this very incompatible with anything, so don't expect it to work with any packs that change the mob textures.

**Q:** Why would anyone ever make this?
> **A:** Because it hasn't been done before and I can
